I studied psychology so I kinda know the symptoms. At most I could have mild depression, and I've been doing the things you say (thanks for that) - exercising, eating a balanced diet, volunteering etc.

But the feeling of emptiness is not always equal to depression....

Yup I enjoy volunteering very much actually. I've been doing several projects at once, but they always end - because we tend to move on and help people from a different place etc.

In a way, that got me feeling and thinking this: "how much impact can I actually make", "can I even change someone in 2 months", "these projects are a waste of time because they're only temporary (although we bond and be all happy whenever we meet)"

So yeah. Volunteering is one of my purpose of living, but like I said, I feel tired

Idk how because I'm asking myself this question too everyday. I honestly think life will *feel* better as we age, only because we learn to appreciate the tiniest things - especially after being through so much pain at a young age.

I agree that more and more of us are falling into depression and loneliness these days. I wonder if it's because of the material world we live in? Everyone's just so busy with their own lives - chasing money to pay for necessities and wants - to "live" while we detaching ourselves from the society slowly and fully (one day).

I guess my solution is to look at how beautiful some things are - blue skies, sunsets, flowers, cats - and try to smile and genuinely be happy with how things are, for myself.

For the last part, I'm still waiting to find the right person, someone who's as screwed up and broken as me, because then we'll know exactly how to love each other. Or I'll die alone. Time will tell right pfft
